title: Prove the Kiln capability signature loads and can be compared
statement: Once the Kiln Pi package exists, extend the compatibility suite to observe that its machine-readable capability signature is present in a loaded session and that a deliberate change to a measured tool signature is detected by a comparing consumer. Until then the suite proves extension, skill and prompt loading only.
notes: The Kiln package exists, and both halves of ACC-0092 now have evidence. Presence: a real loaded Pi session calls kiln_capability and receives the shipped signature.json unchanged (ACC-0109, EVD-0106). Drift: the compatibility suite loads the shipped package and a copy whose research_fetch gains a required property into real Pi sessions, reads every research tool signature from the live registry, and verifyChild(contractFor("research")) accepts the unmodified package and refuses the changed one as signature-mismatch without returning its output (EVD-0122, commit 7c3b8a1). The retained and live tiers apply the same assertion, and the retained records were taken on Windows and WSL Ubuntu 24.04 against Pi 0.84.4. verifyChild compares property names and the required list only, so a type-only change is not detected, and widening that comparison is outside this task. CI run 35591168378 at d927151 passed in all four cells, and the live tier re-proved the result on ubuntu-latest node 24 only. ACC-0092 passed on EVD-0106 and EVD-0122 on 2026-09-21.
